boards.title: Your First Weekend at Rockhurst University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure sequence for learning the Rockhurst campus, meeting people, and taking one nearby Kansas City art walk.

cards.title: 1. Start at Massman Hall
cards.subtitle: Orientation check-in and the main quad
cards.notes: Use orientation check-in near Massman Hall as a starting point, then identify the dining room, bookstore, and paths that lead across campus.
cards.short_summary: Get oriented where Rockhurst directs new students to check in.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst’s orientation information says orientation check-in is near Massman Hall; the campus map lists dining and the bookstore in Massman Hall.
cards.access_notes: Orientation programming and building access vary by date; follow the instructions provided by Student Life.

cards.title: 2. Meet beside the Bell Tower
cards.subtitle: Central-campus landmark
cards.notes: Pick the Bell Tower, Pergola & Fountain as a clear meetup landmark before a short campus walk; save the name in your phone for future directions.
cards.short_summary: Choose a map-listed landmark that is easy to recognize again.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst’s current campus map lists the Bell Tower, Pergola & Fountain as a campus destination.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark; use normal campus pedestrian routes.

cards.title: 3. Find Greenlease Library
cards.subtitle: Northwest-central campus
cards.notes: Walk to Greenlease Library and locate its entrance, then note the route back to the quad so you have a dependable academic landmark for week one.
cards.short_summary: Put the campus library on your mental map before classes begin.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst’s security and accessibility map identifies Greenlease Library in the northwest-central area of campus.
cards.access_notes: Check library access and service hours before planning an indoor visit.

cards.title: 4. Spot Greenlease Gallery
cards.subtitle: A named campus gallery stop
cards.notes: Add Greenlease Gallery to the walk and check its posted information when you arrive; it is a distinct map-listed destination beside the library area.
cards.short_summary: Notice a campus arts destination during the first loop.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst’s current campus map lists Greenlease Gallery as a campus building destination.
cards.access_notes: Gallery programming and access may vary; consult posted information on arrival.

cards.title: 5. Pause at Mabee Chapel
cards.subtitle: Campus chapel
cards.notes: Take a quiet pause outside Mabee Chapel, then continue your walk toward the athletic side of campus; respect any service or private-use signage.
cards.short_summary: Use a named chapel as a calm point in the campus loop.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst’s current campus map lists Mabee Chapel as a campus destination.
cards.access_notes: Observe posted access guidance and any scheduled worship services.

cards.title: 6. Locate the MAC
cards.subtitle: Magis Activity Center recreation facility
cards.notes: Stop by the Magis Activity Center to identify the facility and ask about current student recreation, workout-class, or intramural options for the semester.
cards.short_summary: Find the campus recreation hub and its current participation options.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst says students can participate in intramural sports, activities, and workout classes at the Magis Activity Center.
cards.access_notes: Ask MAC staff about eligibility, schedules, and any required student ID.

cards.title: 7. Grab a meal at the Rock Room
cards.subtitle: Massman Hall lower level
cards.notes: Meet a new classmate for a meal or snack in the Rock Room, and confirm which counters are open before choosing where to eat.
cards.short_summary: Use a campus dining location for an easy, daytime social stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst Dining Services lists Sushi Do and The Market at the Rock Room, and the student handbook places it in Massman Hall’s lower level.
cards.access_notes: Purchases or meal-plan access may be required; confirm current operating hours and accepted payment.

cards.title: 8. Check the Bourke Field schedule
cards.subtitle: Rockhurst Hawks home field
cards.notes: Look at the current Hawks schedule, then attend a listed home match at Bourke Field if it fits your weekend and ticket details are confirmed.
cards.short_summary: Turn a scheduled home event into a simple shared plan.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst Athletics lists 2026 men’s soccer home games at Bourke Field in Kansas City.
cards.source_title: 2026 Men's Soccer Schedule | Rockhurst University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Only attend a currently scheduled event; verify start time, weather plan, and admission details with Athletics.

cards.title: 9. Finish the campus loop at the Convocation Center
cards.subtitle: North of Bourke Field
cards.notes: Walk past the Convocation Center and Mason-Halpin Fieldhouse to connect the academic quad with the athletics area before heading off campus.
cards.short_summary: Complete the campus geography loop through the athletic facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst’s security and accessibility map places the Convocation Center and Mason-Halpin Fieldhouse north of Bourke Field.
cards.access_notes: Facility access and event entry depend on current programming; use public walkways and posted guidance.

cards.title: 10. Take a daylight art walk at the Sculpture Park
cards.subtitle: Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art, Kansas City
cards.notes: Make a daytime plan to walk the Donald J. Hall Sculpture Park, using the museum’s map and sunrise-to-sundown access window to set your timing.
cards.short_summary: End the weekend with a free, outdoor museum walk.
cards.evidence_claim: The Nelson-Atkins states that the Donald J. Hall Sculpture Park is free to visit and open from sunrise to sundown.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | The Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Outdoor sculpture park access is sunrise to sundown; museum indoor hours and parking policies are separate.
